You melt the crowns into tools and unbolt the engine. Its last breath rolls across a world that has forgotten silence.

There is no throne now. No next carriage, no final boss, no promise that the road ahead will be kind. You step off the tracks, and the others follow.

For the first time, nobody knows where the journey ends.

You throw the final switch and bring the railway home. The carriages become houses; the engine warms gardens instead of feeding fire.

You hang the four crowns above a ticket window that will never charge a fare. Everyone gets a key. For once, staying is a choice.

Tomorrow, you will help build the platform.
